description: Fable-led Astra Teams — a `team-fable-astra` preset for `compose build --team`: Fable (claude-fable-5-1) plans and assesses as ordinary steps, Astra workers (gpt-6-astra) implement in bounded waves in isolated worktrees, a fresh Astra reviewer checks the integrated result, and the gate revise edge drives a repair wave covering only affected tasks; waves are the dependency mechanism. Epic with Stratum prerequisites: STRAT-LOOP-CARRY (a declared, persisted flow variable updated on gate revise, since a fanout over a later step's output is a routing cycle and the revise reset deletes it) and STRAT-FLOW-CANCEL-FG (foreground flow cancel), plus four Compose seams (output-driven gate resolution with validators, wave-checkpoint branch with reconciliation, files_owned enforcement at merge from the engine-recorded item, per-item tier resolution so Fable picks critical/standard/fast per task and a wave mixes Astra with terra or spark). Provider stays per stage: the TS engine's agent field is a literal enum, so cross-provider per-item routing is a follow-up. Slice 1 bumps the Claude tier table and closes the fail-open sidecar. Design: [design.md](docs/features/COMP-FABLE-ASTRA/design.md). **Status 2026-09-13: slices 1, 3 and 4 are SHIPPED and RELEASED** — slice 3 at 53e3710 (real-engine wave golden 6/6), slice 4 at ce3069e (the `team-fable-astra` preset, sidecar, named contracts and `--team fable-astra`), released 2026-09-10 as stratum 0.5.2 (surface 20) and compose + compose-mcp 0.5.1, both tagged and pushed. Remaining: slice 6 live-fire, which the owner HELD — it is waiting on a spend decision, not on engineering. Ledger: [progress.md](docs/features/COMP-FABLE-ASTRA/progress.md).

links.note: messaging, ordering and merge-conflict machinery stay there
